args.summary: Walled assault played for a long time. The setup screen was clear. In battle, the win bar stayed at 100% for a long stretch, and I got little feedback on walls and gate damage. The dense army blob was hard to read. The Enemy button, which cycles through targets, was helpful. The attrition readout and the prompts about burning base buildings were useful but cluttered the screen. The battle never showed me a clear result screen. Overall the battle was slow and hard to read, so I'm ending the session here.

thought: Wrapping up; the battle is a slow attrition grind and I have covered every checklist area.

args.summary: Modern walled city assault. I could not tell whether the Attack command and Rally Cry did anything. Morale and the win bar kept falling, from 58% to 15% for me against 42% for the enemy. Many units sat idle and I kept re-selecting them with the Idle button. The attack prompt appears only briefly. The battle was confusing and I was losing at the end. I looked at every checklist area. Main fixes: make the attack orders and prompts clearer, give feedback when a power is used, and stop units going idle on their own.

thought: Losing badly and have covered the checklist; ending the session.
